Class IInteger

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.common.SysMLAnything
sysmlinjava.attributetypes.SysMLAttributeType
sysmlinjava.attributetypes.IInteger
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, ObservableAttribute
Direct Known Subclasses:
DurationMilliseconds, InstantMilliseconds, QuantityEach
public class IInteger extends SysMLAttributeType implements Serializable
SysMLinJava value type for the SysML Integer.

* Note that the Integer name clashes with the java.lang.Integer name. Therefore, this SysMLinJava version uses the double I spelling.

This representation of the integer type is for a generic integer as used in SysML. Hence the use of a Java long for its value. This SysML integer is not the same as the java int or Integer types as SysML does not discriminate between bit-lengths of numeric types as does the Java language.

Note: as an ObservableValue implementation, this value type can be "observed" by other objects. ValueObservers call the addValueObserver() operation to be notiified (called-back) by the Int object of any change in its value. This notification will only occur if and when the IInteger value is changed by a call to the setValue(), increment(), or decrement() operations. So, while the IInteger value is publicly accessible and can be changed by direct assignment, one of the value changing operations must be used if ValueObservers are to be notified of the change.
